title: Detection Versus Violation Decision
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of object detection labels and downstream rules, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in helmet-seatbelt-violation-detection.
learning_objectives: Explain object detection labels and downstream rules in plain language and connect it to source/main_app.py; source/helmet_detection_yolo8_max_accuracy.py.
Trace one input through the detection versus violation decision stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: object detection labels and downstream rules
practical_outcomes: Trace the detection versus violation decision stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for object detection labels and downstream rules.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
